name: Vaultwarden
description: A password manager server that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.

ports.description: Web vault and the apps' server address

volumes.description: The password database, attachments and keys

env.name: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
env.description: While true, anyone who can reach Vaultwarden may create an account. Set it to false once your accounts exist

notes: The web vault only works in a secure context, so Open uses http://localhost on this computer. For phones and other computers, give it an https:// address with Nginx Proxy Manager and add the variable DOMAIN with that address (Edit). Create your accounts, then set SIGNUPS_ALLOWED to false.
